description:
Follow-up after the graph records input_demand. tested_input_ordinals (src/compiler2/dispatch_reachability.rs:276-288) asks "which ordinals does a Test predicate read", scans every graph node rather than reachable ones, and returns EVERY input whenever plan.guards is non-empty. Its sole consumer, calculate_dispatch_reachability (:37-46), uses it to decide which root slots get runtime_envelope and which pass through so a type variable survives (fz-f98.14.11).

Serving it from the recorded fact with a tested flavor (Untouched | Projected | Tested per ordinal) deletes the fourth scanner, but changes the answer for guarded functions: more inputs stay un-enveloped, more type variables survive into outcome_inputs, and the fixpoint can move. That is a decision with its own signal, taken after the recording lands: the guard fixtures' activation counts and the census ratchets, compared before and after.
title: Reachability reads a tested flavor of the plan's recorded input demand
